text:
Priya: uploaded a quick prototype for a 'rewind scrubber' on the version history timeline. idea: show a small marker when a rollback occurs and allow micro-rewind to the exact snapshot. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc/rewind-scrubber-proto

Marta: nice! the marker makes sense. question: should rewind snap to the snapshot or allow fine-grain frame-by-frame scrub?

Jin: for large deployments frame-by-frame is noisy. prefer snap points at commits/snapshots + a short hover preview image.

Diego: UX note: when users scrub back, we should visually indicate that they're in "preview" mode and not actually rewinding traffic. maybe a floating pill: "Previewing version 2026-03-10 (click Apply to rollback)"

Alex (A11y): accessibility: ensure the scrubber is keyboard operable. arrow keys to move between snap points, Home/End to jump start/end, and when focus lands on a snapshot marker announce date + author + tag. Example SR string: "Snapshot March 10, 2026 by Marta: canary at 10%"

Priya: agreed on preview pill. also adding an explicit \"Apply rollback\" CTA in the preview, and a secondary \"Compare\" that opens a side-by-side diff.

Marta: microcopy: what about the confirmation flow? options: 1) modal with checklist 2) inline confirm bar with undoable action 3) toast + rollback job status panel. any preferences?

Jin: I'd avoid modal unless it's destructive. Rollback is often used to recover. make it inline confirm bar with a strong CTA and a short cooldown undo (30s).

Diego: slight worry: inline confirm could be missed. maybe combine: inline confirm bar for power users and a small persistent timeline badge showing rollback in progress that opens a status panel.

Alex (A11y): modal accessibility if used: `role=\"alertdialog\"` for urgent rollbacks, focus on the primary action, and include clear aria-describedby text listing what will change. For inline bars, ensure they are reachable by skip links and that the undo control is keyboard reachable. Also ensure color is not the only affordance (add icons and text).

Priya: animation note: when moving the scrubber between snap points, use reduced-motion-sensitive transitions. respect user's OS preference.

Marta: visual contrast: the preview pill needs to be distinct but not alarming. propose using a soft indigo background with a black label: "Previewing snapshot" and an action: "Apply rollback" (primary).

Jin: timeline zoom levels: we have compact (1h-24h), medium (1d-14d), and expanded (month history). snapshot markers should collapse in compact and expand on hover/zoom.

Alex (A11y): keyboard shortcuts: propose `R` to enter rewind preview when focus is within timeline, `Enter` to apply when on a marker, and `Esc` to exit preview. Announce shortcut availability in the timeline help menu and in the tooltip. Make sure customizable in docs.

Diego: small copy nit for the rollback CTA: prefer "Apply rollback" over "Rollback" because it's clearer. Also add the target percent in the pill: "Apply rollback to version x (0% -> 100%)"

Priya: implemented that copy in figma. also added a small dot badge that remains on the scrubber when previewing so folks know where the live traffic is vs preview.

Marta: can we add an explicit SR announcement when someone else initiates a rollback? e.g., "Team Alert: rollback started by Jin at 14:22". That should be separate from the UI live region.

Alex (A11y): yes, sounds good. use a polite live region for non-blocking updates and a focused alertdialog for critical, irreversible changes. For collaborator events, include `aria-atomic` so screen readers read the full message.

design-bot: prototype uploaded: feat/rewind-scrubber -> https://preview.redwood.dev/preview/rewind-scrubber (expires in 48h)

Jin: i'll test keyboard flow and look at collapsed-state behaviour. tagging @Alex (A11y) for SR walkthrough after deploy.

Priya: thanks all, i'll iterate on the compact collapse behaviour and add the preview pill copy variations. back with updates tomorrow. :sparkles:
